items.title: OpenAI Enhances GPT-5.6 Sol and Expands GPT-5.6 Luna Access for Free Users
items.summary: OpenAI announces significant improvements to its GPT-5.6 Sol model within ChatGPT and is making the advanced GPT-5.6 Luna model more widely available to free users.

items.title: OpenAI's New AI Smart Speaker Reportedly Priced Between $300-$400
items.summary: OpenAI is reportedly planning to launch an AI-powered smart speaker, with an anticipated price point ranging from $300 to $400, signaling its entry into consumer hardware.

items.title: ChatGPT Now Offers Unlimited Text Chats to All Free Users
items.summary: OpenAI has removed previous restrictions, allowing all ChatGPT free users to engage in unlimited text conversations, significantly expanding access to its AI capabilities.

items.title: Naïve Secures $28.5M to Automate Company Setup and Operations
items.summary: Naïve has raised $28.5 million in funding to develop AI solutions aimed at automating the administrative and operational tasks involved in establishing and running a business.

items.title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents with Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
items.summary: A new research paper introduces ABSeeker, a method that uses answer-backtracked credit assignment to effectively train AI agents for complex, long-horizon search tasks.

items.title: OpenAI Partners with American Psychological Association on Youth Mental Health and AI
items.summary: OpenAI is collaborating with the American Psychological Association to explore and advance responsible AI applications concerning youth mental health.

items.title: OneDayAgent: A New Framework for Long-Horizon Autonomous Agents
items.summary: Researchers present OneDayAgent, a novel framework designed to improve the capabilities and reliability of autonomous agents in tackling long-horizon tasks.

items.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: A new paper introduces AgentOPSD, a technique utilizing recursive self-distillation to enhance the learning efficiency and performance of agentic reinforcement learning systems.

items.title: I Recreated Management With AI: 9 Things I Do Differently
items.summary: An individual shares insights on how they leveraged AI to transform their management practices, detailing nine key changes and improvements.

items.title: Inside Google's 353,000-Person AI Agents Intensive Coding Course
items.summary: Google provides an inside look at its massive 'AI Agents Intensive' coding course, highlighting the scale and impact of its developer education initiatives.

items.title: The Channel Gap: Why Your LLM Judge is Blind in One Eye
items.summary: This article critically examines the limitations of using LLMs as evaluators, arguing that they often suffer from a 'channel gap' that hinders comprehensive judgment.

items.title: GDPevo: Evaluating Agent Self-Evolution on Real Business Tasks
items.summary: Researchers introduce GDPevo, a new benchmark and methodology for evaluating the ability of AI agents to self-evolve and adapt when performing real-world business tasks.

items.title: Ego2Robot: Scalable Robot Data Synthesis from Egocentric Human Data
items.summary: A new paper proposes Ego2Robot, a method for generating scalable and realistic robot training data by synthesizing it from egocentric human video recordings.

items.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
items.summary: This research explores 'skill entropy' as a metric for benchmarking and training Large Language Models to improve their long-horizon reasoning capabilities, aiming for more 'skill-native' LLMs.

items.title: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale
items.summary: WorldClaw introduces a new approach for scalable, agentic generation of complex 3D open-world environments, pushing the boundaries of virtual world creation.
